name: stars-background
title: Stars Background
description: A field of twinkling stars placed from a fixed seed, so every render looks the same. Best in dark mode.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of stars, up to 400. More stars make a denser sky.

props.name: seed
props.description: Whole number that decides star positions. The same seed always gives the same sky.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the stars.

a11y: The star layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
With reduced motion, stars stop twinkling and keep their own brightness.

ai.whenToUse: A night sky behind a launch hero, event countdown, or waitlist card, especially in dark mode.
rules: Set the background color, padding, and radius with class on the component
Change seed to get a different but stable layout
Keep count under 200 for cards and small sections

id.description: Bidang bintang berkelip yang posisinya dari seed tetap, jadi setiap render terlihat sama. Paling cocok di mode gelap.

props.count: Jumlah bintang, maksimal 400. Makin banyak, langit makin rapat.
props.seed: Bilangan bulat yang menentukan posisi bintang. Seed sama selalu menghasilkan langit yang sama.
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas bintang.

a11y: Lapisan bintang memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer.
Dengan reduced motion, bintang berhenti berkelip dan tetap pada kecerahannya masing-masing.

ai.whenToUse: Langit malam di belakang hero peluncuran, hitung mundur acara, atau kartu waitlist, terutama di mode gelap.
rules: Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
Ganti seed untuk tata letak lain yang tetap stabil
Jaga count di bawah 200 untuk kartu dan section kecil
